main.summary: Identifies how an input value is used when updating a DataItem field-integrity digest.

value.name: HashRawData
value.summary: Compute SHA-512 over the supplied raw field bytes.

value.name: StorePrecomputedDigest
value.summary: Store the supplied digest without hashing it again.

value.name: ComputeContentProjection
value.summary: Compute the DataItem content-integrity digest from its explicit canonical projection.
